mapper.select: SELECT MIN(pa.id) FROM protected_area pa WHERE ST_Contains(pa.boundary, ST_SRID(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326))

SELECT s.id AS id, ST_Latitude(s.location) AS lat, ST_Longitude(s.location) AS lng, s.park_warning AS parkWarning, s.version AS version FROM spot s WHERE s.type = 'BAKJI' AND s.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit}
